strings:
OPT-IN via `?modal=1`, and deliberately NOT in the committed capture: a fixture carrying an
       open modal would also need `DOM.getTopLayerElements`' answer committed beside it, and a
       recorded empty set over a page that has one is the lie `real_captures()` warns about. This
       shape is measured by PIXELS instead — does a modal in the CHILD document escape the
       PARENT's transparent/hidden container, the way one escapes an in-document one?
